Who are Jamie's Computers?
The Society of St James (SSJ) , trading as Jamie's Computers , is a UK registered charity. SSJ is a Southampton-based homelessness charity, providing a range of supported living services in Southampton, Portsmouth and across Hampshire. We provide a wide range of support to people from all walks of life experiencing homelessness, problematic alcohol or substance use and mental health problems.
Set up by SSJ in 2002, Jamies helps recycle all kinds of IT and computer equipment, both professionally and ethically. We're located in Southampton. 70% of donated equipment is reused, recycled and upcycled to Microsoft standards. The rest is broken down into components and recycled, meaning that 0% of material goes to landfill. We also provide volunteering opportunities to give individuals the chance to learn practical skills in a real business environment.
Payment
Jamie's computers only accepts payments through eBay for items purchased on eBay. Items sold through auction must be paid for within 30 days. After 30 days the item is then offered to the next highest bidder.
Shipping
Jamie's Computers will only accept orders with a UK mainland shipping address. We aim to ship all items within 3 working days of payment using DHL, Royal Mail or FedEx. We do not ship items over the weekends. Items may be collected from our storefront on weekdays between 09:00 and 16:00 by arrangement. Please ensure you bring your eBay collection code with you.
VAT Invoices
Jamie's Computers is the trading arm of The Society of St James, a registered charity. Under UK tax law, charities are entitled to a specific VAT relief known as "zero-rating" on the sale of donated goods. Because the items we sell were donated to us for the purpose of fundraising, the VAT rate applied to these sales is 0%. Since no VAT is actually charged on the transaction, we cannot provide an invoice showing a standard 20% VAT amount. This government relief is designed to ensure that 100% of your purchase price goes directly toward supporting our mission rather than being diverted to tax.
Returns
All returns must be conducted via eBay, we cannot organise returns via email or any other channel.
- Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 an online buyer has the right to return an item within 14 days of receiving the item. Under these conditions please initiate a return through eBay, using the "I just don't like it" option. The buyer will pay postage for this return and eBay will automatically refund the buyer once the item arrives back with us.
- Under the eBay Money Back Guarantee, a buyer has 30 calendar days from the actual or last estimated delivery date to initiate a "Significantly Not As Described" (SNAD) return. Under these conditions please select the appropriate option during the returns process, either " Item arrived damaged", "Item doesn't match description/photos" or "Wrong item sent". We will pay the postage for this return and eBay will refund the buyer once the item arrives back with us.
Under both sets of conditions, please ensure the item arrives back with us in the same condition we shipped it. If the item is not in the same condition we must open a case against the buyer for the return.

Cores and Threads Explained
Cores :
These are the physical components within the CPU that perform actual
processing tasks. Having more cores generally means better performance and
the ability to handle more tasks simultaneously.
Threads :
Threads are the smallest sequence of programmed instructions that can be
managed independently by a scheduler. With technologies like
Hyper-Threading (by Intel) or Simultaneous Multi-Threading (by AMD), each
physical core can handle two threads, effectively doubling the number of
tasks the CPU can manage at once.
Why It Matters
Performance :
More cores and threads improve multitasking and performance, especially
for tasks like video editing, gaming, or running multiple applications
simultaneously.
Efficiency :
It allows the CPU to distribute tasks more efficiently, reducing
bottlenecks and improving overall system responsiveness.
Think of it like having 6 chefs (cores) in a kitchen, each
capable of handling two dishes (threads) at the same time. So, your kitchen can
work on 12 dishes simultaneously, improving the efficiency of your culinary
operation!

Description
Rigorously tested and guaranteed fully functional. Our grades are; Platinum - Practically Perfect, Gold - Minor signs of use, Silver - Obvious signs of use, Bronze - well used.
About MDT
MyDigitalTech is the retail branch of one of the world’s largest electronics reuse and recycling companies, for refurbishing and disposing of their surplus IT and telecoms equipment.
Our stock comes from the companies and agencies who bought top-quality new stock and kept it well maintained. We collect these units and bring them to our asset recovery facility where we work our IT magic! First we data wipe the equipment, ensuring that it no longer contains any data from a former user. They are then put through a rigorous testing programme before being cleaned inside and out.
Finally, as one of only a handful of Microsoft Authorized Refurbishers in the UK, we install a genuine Windows operating system on all compatible products.
Now, your equipment is ready to use as soon as you open the box.
If you have any queries regarding our eBay store or any of the information or materials contained on or in it, please contact us.
Our Grading Explained
NEW SEALED - Exactly what it says - an unused item in a sealed box.
NEW OPEN - The item is still unused, but the box has been opened. All original accessories are included.
PLATINUM - Just as you’d expect from an item bearing a Platinum badge- virtually indistinguishable from new. No marks, no scuffs, no blemishes, no scratches, and no dents!
GOLD - Gold units almost made the top grade, but fell just short. Not that you can easily tell. These units will show minor signs of use, but are excellent value for money.
SILVER - If you want functionality and low cost, then our Silver units are perfect for you. These items have the functionality of their Gold and Platinum counterparts, but with a much lower price tag. They do show obvious signs of use, though- scratches, scuffs or dents might be visible.
BRONZE - The best price available, and fully functional, but will look a little rough.
Shipping
At MyDigitalTech, we do everything possible to get your order to you as quickly and safely as possible. Orders are dispatched within one business day, and we offer free delivery to most areas of the UK through our couriers. International orders are trackable through the courriers website, priced economy 3+ days for best value for money and insured.
Product FAQs
I am buying “refurbished” kit. What does that mean?
Our refurbished equipment isn’t brand new, it just looks and operates that way. Your refurbished item was originally owned by a large corporation or agency. Our parent company Sims Lifecycle Services, contracts to take that equipment and completely wipe it of all existing data. Then they pass the equipment over to MyDigitalTech. We take the equipment, thoroughly clean it inside and output it through an enhanced test to ensure that it’s good for sale. Where applicable, we’ll install a new operating system and deliver it to you ready to use straight out of the box.
What can a new computer do that a refurbished one can’t?
Depending on what one you buy….Nothing! Refurbished laptops and desktops are great for browsing the Internet, home office work and watching streaming movies and television, some of them are even powerful enough to run large programmes like Photoshop. By choosing a refurbished computer you are getting a great piece of equipment at a bargain price.
Will my computer arrive ready to use?
Yes! We are a Microsoft Authorized Refurbisher, so your computer will arrive installed with a genuine Windows operating system.
Do you also sell new items?
Yes, we do. New items come from the same companies and distributors that supply the stock we refurbish. New items will arrive in their unopened, original packaging.
Why do some of the same products have different prices?
We have a large stock of products that come in different conditions. We grade them as platinum, gold and silver so that you know their cosmetic condition. Platinum products are virtually indistinguishable from new, gold products show minor signs of use and silver products might show visible scratches, scuffs or dents. The products are priced accordingly.
Why should I buy refurbished instead of new stock?
Refurbished stock is excellent value for money. You are getting great products from top manufacturers, with genuine Microsoft operating systems (where applicable) and cleaned like new for a fraction of the price of new equipment.
Where do the products come from?
Our stock started out as IT equipment being used by agencies or large companies. It has been used for a limited period of time and well maintained. Our parent group, Sims Lifecycle Services, has contracts to refurbish and redistribute this equipment, providing us with a great variety of quality products.
What comes in the box?
This varies by product. Review product descriptions for specific details for what is included in your purchase.
As you shop, we will also make suggestions for additional pieces you might want to purchase to enhance your kit. For example, desktop computers will come with a power cord, but not a keyboard or mouse
What comes installed?

listings.title: Asus ROG Strix G18(FRENCH KEYBOARD)INTELCORE I9-13980HX NVIDIAGEFORCE RTX 4070.
listings.description:
You can't beat the enemy if you don't see them coming. To accommodate such powerful components, the Strix G's chassis and motherboard were both redesigned to accommodate our new full-width heatsink, whose fins were moved even closer to the exhaust vents for more efficient cooling.
Introducing the ROG Strix G18
Reach new heights of Windows 11 Gaming performance with the Strix G18, featuring 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i9-13980HX Processor and an NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 4070 Laptop GPU and a dedicated MUX Switch with NVIDIA Advanced Optimus. Sporting all new 16- and 18-inch Nebula displays and full-surround vents with Tri-Fan Technology, the 2023 ROG Strix G18 are here to change the way you game.
Power up your play
Draw more frames and win more games with the brand new Strix G and Windows 11 Home. Powered by a 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i9-13980HX Processor and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU with Dynamic Boost, be ready to dominate the competition in all of the latest games. Backed up with a dedicated MUX Switch and NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the Strix G unlocks the true potential of its hardware. With 1TB PCIe Gen4x4 SSD storage and 32GB of 4800MHz DDR5 RAM, large game libraries and intense multitasking sessions are a breeze for this gaming machine.
ROG Intelligent Cooling
To accommodate such powerful components, the Strix G's chassis and motherboard were both redesigned to accommodate our new full-width heatsink, whose fins were moved even closer to the exhaust vents for more efficient cooling. The full-width heatsink is built from three different sections, surrounding the motherboard with densely-packed fins for a total surface area of 174,183-195,509mm², up to 92% increase from the 2022 Strix G series. This design maximizes the available pathing for hot air to escape the machine and drastically increases overall airflow.
Finally, most gaming laptops have a dual fan cooling system, but the Strix G was able to push the performance envelope even further with the introduction of a third fan that helps keep the GPU and VRAM cool. Paired with seven heatpipes and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal on both the CPU and GPU* the Strix G's cooling system is a marvel of engineering.
ROG Nebula Display
You can't beat the enemy if you don't see them coming. The Strix G has ultra-fast panel options for every scenario, making sure you'll never miss a moment. For the first time ever, this 18-inch machine offer QHD+ 240Hz Nebula displays. A 16:10 panel with 500 nits of brightness, 100% DCI-P3 coverage and 3ms response times, the Strix G has pixel-perfect precision even in the most frenetic firefights. The Strix G is also available with a Full HD 165Hz panel, with each option offering fantastic color, Dolby Vision, G-Sync support, and an 89% screen-to-body ratio for a stellar gaming and viewing experience.
Built for victory.
The Republic of Gamers was built by those who love to play video games. All ROG designs come with gamers in mind, from the chassis, lighting integration, software controls, and macro functions. These ROG exclusive design features not only give you a competitive advantage, but they make sure you never blend in with the crowd.
Studio-quality Sound
Dual Dolby Atmos-powered speakers create an authentic sound stage for your games. Hi-Res audio ensures you hear your music in the same quality it was recorded. Two-Way AI Noise Cancelation processes both incoming and outgoing audio to filter any errant background noises, making sure that your calls, chats and streams come through without distraction.
All Day Endurance
The Strix G is ready to go the distance. Featuring a 90Wh battery, the laptop can easily browse the web for hours away from the wall before needing a recharge. For flexibility on the go, USB Type-C charging is supported up to 100W. When charging using the supplied 330W power adapter, the Strix G can recharge from zero to 50% in just 30 minutes.
Stay Connected
When you need to plug into the big screen, the dedicated GPU powers an HDMI 2.1 port for the latest TVs and monitors, increasing total bandwidth from 18 to 48Gbps, and supporting up to 4K 120Hz and 8K 60Hz content. Two USB Type-C ports allow for plenty of connectivity-one for DisplayPort and power delivery, and a second with Thunderbolt 4 support.
The 13th Gen Intel Core i9-13980HX processor clocked at 2.2 GHz (up to 5.6 GHz in Boost Mode) with 24 cores (8 P cores and 16 E cores) delivers exceptional performance for a smooth, responsive computing experience. The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 TGP 140W graphics card delivers exceptional graphics performance for gaming and graphics-intensive tasks. listings.description:
Display: 17.0" QHD+ (2560 x 1600) 16:10, 240Hz Refresh Rate, 100% DCI-P3 Color. Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (12GB GDDR7). MSI Vector 17 HX AI (A2XW Series) high-end gaming & workstation laptop.
Up for sale is a brand-new
MSI Vector 17 HX AI (A2XW Series) high-end gaming & workstation laptop.
This unit is unused / open box — it was strictly taken out of the original packaging once to power on, before being repackaged.
The laptop, power brick, protective coverings, and box contents are all present.
This laptop is ideal for:
• High-End Gaming.
• AI Development.
• 4K Video Editing.
• STEM/3D Workstations
Save £300+ off current UK retail prices on a pristine, zero-wear machine!
⚡ Key Technical Specifications
Processor: Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 275HX (24 Cores / 24 Threads, up to 5.4GHz Turbo)
Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (12GB GDDR7)
Storage: 2TB NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD (Factory Installed)
Memory: 32GB DDR5 RAM
Display: 17.0" QHD+ (2560 x 1600) 16:10, 240Hz Refresh Rate, 100% DCI-P3 Color
Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, 2.5G Ethernet, Thunderbolt™ 5 / USB4, HDMI 2.1
OS: Windows 11 Home
📦 What’s Included?
Everything is included exactly as supplied by the manufacturer:
1. MSI Vector 17 HX AI Laptop (Cosmos Gray)
2. Original MSI 330W Power Adapter & UK Power Cable
3. Original Factory Packaging, Inner Protective Foam & Documentation
🚚 Shipping & Security Terms
Fast Dispatch: Shipped within 1 business day of cleared payment.
Fully Insured Postage:
Dispatched via Royal Mail Special Delivery (Insured up to £2,500) with Signature Required on Delivery. The cost of this will be £35.00 and is the only shipping method used.
Security:
Serial numbers have been protected (Censored) in the photos and will be sent to the purchaser upon sale and cleared funds and the dispatch packing process are documented to protect both buyer and seller.
(This is to protect us both as scams are active where scammers will use serial numbers in order to make fraudulent claims)
This laptop is the complete package and can do all you’ll ever need it too.
Below are some of the things you can use this laptop for.
1. 🤖 Local AI & Machine Learning Development
Why this laptop excels: The Intel Core Ultra 9 features a dedicated Neural Processing Unit (NPU) for low-power AI tasks, while the RTX 5070 Ti (12GB VRAM) provides massive Tensor-core AI power.
Use Cases: Running local LLMs (like Llama or Mistral) offline without relying on cloud subscriptions, fine-tuning machine learning models, running Stable Diffusion for instant local image/video generation, and coding AI agents.
2. 🎬 4K/8K Video Editing & Color Grading
Why this laptop excels: The 17-inch display features a 16:10 aspect ratio with 100% DCI-P3 color coverage, which is cinema-grade standard. Paired with 32GB DDR5 RAM and a fast 2TB NVMe SSD, it scrub-edits heavy footage with zero lag.
Use Cases: Editing multi-camera 4K/8K RAW footage in DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro, applying heavy real-time color grades, and rendering complex VFX in After Effects without proxy files.
3. 🏗️ 3D Modeling, Rendering & CAD Engineering
Why this laptop excels: Professional 3D software relies heavily on raw GPU CUDA cores and high CPU single/multi-thread speeds. The Vector 17 HX handles heavy structural and geometric datasets easily.
Use Cases: Architectural visualization (ArchViz) in Blender, Unreal Engine 5, V-Ray, or Maya; industrial CAD design in SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Revit; and real-time ray-traced architectural walkthroughs.
4. 🧬 Data Science, STEM & Complex Simulations
Why this laptop excels: MSI explicitly designs the Vector line for STEM professionals. The 24-core CPU processes massive computational threads simultaneously.
Use Cases: Financial modeling, statistical analysis in R or Python, running Docker containers, compiling massive software codebases, and running finite element analysis (FEA) or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations.
5. 🎧 Live Streaming & Broadcast Production
Why this laptop excels: With Thunderbolt ports and Wi-Fi 7 / 2.5G Ethernet, it functions as a mobile broadcast studio.
Use Cases: Multi-input live streaming via OBS Studio, high-bitrate encoding using NVIDIA’s NVENC encoder without dropping video frames, and managing live audio production or podcasts on the go.
This laptop was purchased for me as a Birthday Present, but due to ill health I’ve not used it.
Any questions feel free to contact me.
Many thanks.

Whether you’re gaming, watching movies, or making video calls, this audio system delivers rich, high-definition sound with deep bass and clear dialogue. The built-in microphone ensures precise voice capture for communication and streaming.
Windows 11 for an Optimized Gaming and Productivity Experience
Preloaded with Windows 11, the ExoBook 16 harnesses the power of DirectX 12 Ultimate, Auto HDR, and DirectStorage to enhance gaming visuals and reduce load times. With an optimized interface for multitasking, this operating system improves workflow efficiency and overall user experience.
Sleek, Portable Design with RGB Backlit Keyboard
Despite its powerhouse performance, the ExoBook 16 maintains a slim and lightweight design, weighing only 2.25kg and measuring just 20mm in height. About GreenGreenStore
GreenGreenStore is an online retailer based in the UK, specialising in premium refurbished and like-new electronics, including laptops and desktops. We focus on great value, quality products and service to match.
Buying refurbished helps reduce e-waste by keeping good equipment in circulation for longer. Extending the life of tech can reduce your carbon footprint, while also giving you more specification for your money than buying new at the same price point.
Before ordering

Photos are used to show the actual item or the item type clearly, depending on the product details.

VAT
Standard VAT and VAT margin scheme explained
The standard VAT scheme is charged at 20%, where an eligible VAT registered UK business may be able to claim this back. EU customers: we are unable to zero-rate VAT through this listing.
The VAT margin scheme is frequently used for second-hand and refurbished goods. Where the margin scheme applies, the price you see includes VAT, but VAT cannot be claimed back or displayed separately on the invoice.
How does the VAT margin scheme affect you?
If you are a consumer buying for personal use, it does not affect you. The price you see is the price you pay. If you are a VAT registered business, or another organisation that could normally claim back VAT on eligible purchases, you will not be able to claim back VAT on goods sold under the VAT margin scheme.
Delivery and returns
Delivery
Getting your item to you quickly and safely is important to us, so we use premium tracked courier services. Orders placed by 11am on working days are normally sent on a next-working-day service, typically with DPD where available.
You can enter your mobile number at checkout to receive tracking updates, where supported by the courier.
Delivery is during working days only. Orders placed on Friday or around a bank holiday will normally arrive early the following week. Where next-day service is unavailable, for example Northern Ireland or the Scottish Highlands, we may use a 2 to 3 day service.
If you have a non-standard UK address, such as an armed forces address, please contact us if additional postal instructions may be needed.
Returns
Within the first 30 days, you may return your order for repair or refund in line with marketplace returns and the listing terms. After 30 days, a refund is only arranged if repair or replacement is not available.
You are responsible for removing any personal data from your device before returning it.
Please return the item in the same condition as received. If the item is damaged, we may reduce the refund value proportionately.
EU and international orders
EU and international shipping may be fulfilled by the marketplace's international shipping programme or equivalent service where available.
We use the same prompt dispatch service to send the parcel for onward processing, after which the marketplace or courier handles international delivery.
If you are an EU buyer, we typically swap the UK plug cable for an EU cable where suitable and available.

Victory Accelerated
Game with the greatest, backed up by the power of an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. With 8 Performance and 16 Efficient cores, this next-gen silicon can drive high framerates in esports and AAA games alike. The G16 also has access to AI acceleration in select content creation apps, giving you incredible flexibility on how you can utilise this machine. The 2025 Strix G16 offers the very best Windows 11 gaming experience, featuring an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU with 8GB of VRAM and Advanced Optimus functionality. This killer hardware is complemented by 32GB of 5600MHz DDR5 RAM and 1TB of PCIe 4.0 storage.
A Dominant Force
High-performance gaming machines need high-performance processors, and up to Intel Core Ultra 9 processor 275HX absolutely delivers. With 24 cores and 24 threads, this gaming and multi-tasking beast can draw up to 75W when needed, ensuring that your games always stay buttery smooth.
Game Changer
Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell, GeForce RTX 50 Series Laptop GPUs bring game-changing capabilities to gamers and creators. Equipped with a massive level of AI horsepower, the RTX 50 Series enables new experiences and next-level graphics fidelity. Multiply performance with NVIDIA DLSS 4, generate images at unprecedented speed, and unleash your creativity with NVIDIA Studio. All in the thinnest and longest lasting RTX laptops, optimised by Max-Q.
NVIDIA Advanced Optimus
With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can automatically route frames from the discrete GPU directly to the display using a MUX switch, bypassing the integrated graphics. This pathing improves performance by 5-10% compared to machines without a MUX Switch, making sure you get the absolute best gaming experience--all without needing touch a single button. This automatic switching also preserves your machine's battery life, as it can dynamically transition between the high-power discrete GPU and the lower power integrated GPU. No matter what you’re doing, your machine will switch to the most optimised mode without you having to lift a finger.
ROG Nebula Display You can’t beat the enemy if you don’t see them coming. The Strix G16 boasts an ultra-fast 2.5K 240Hz Nebula display with a 3ms response time, ensuring you’ll always get the jump on your opponent. A 16:10 panel with 500 nits of brightness and 100% DCI-P3 coverage, the Strix G16 has incredible colour accuracy with pixel-perfect precision even in the most frenetic firefights. ASUS have also added a brand new ACR (Ambient Contrast Ratio) film, with two layers that cut down on glare to increase contrast for more vibrant visuals, as well as improving off-angle viewing for when you might have a spectator.
ACR Technology
This year, ASUS even added two layers of Ambient Contrast Ratio film to the display, which reduces reflections by 55% and provides up to 4.5x better contrast, ensuring the image stays punchy, vivid, and accurate. A second layer boosts viewing angle for a 180° ultra-clear view, providing an image that looks just as good off-center as it does straight on. This machine doesn't just perform at a high level – it draws you into the visuals, with colours so realistic it’s as if you were right in the middle of the action.
A Breath of Fresh Air
The cooling solution of the 2025 Strix G16 has also undergone a redseign, to ensure that you get the best gaming experience with your machine, every time. ASUS have relocated all of the exhaust vents to the rear of the hinge, keeping warm air away from your mousing hand. The sides and bottom of the machine act as an air intake, creating a natural, efficient path for airflow. Air also flows through the keyboard deck, keeping your hands cooler during intense gaming sessions. When pairing an end-to-end vapor chamber with a sandwiched heatsink, Tri-Fan Technology, and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal on both CPU & GPU, the 2025 Strix G16 achieves a lower noise level in Turbo Mode compared to the previous generation, while still offering the same calculated excellence you expect from a Strix machine.

ROG Nebula Display You can’t beat the enemy if you don’t see them coming. The Strix G16 boasts an ultra-fast 2.5K 240Hz Nebula display with a 3ms response time, ensuring you’ll always get the jump on your opponent. A 16:10 panel with 500 nits of brightness and 100% DCI-P3 coverage, the Strix G16 has incredible colour accuracy with pixel-perfect precision even in the most frenetic firefights. ASUS have also added a brand new ACR (Ambient Contrast Ratio) film, with two layers that cut down on glare to increase contrast for more vibrant visuals, as well as improving off-angle viewing for when you might have a spectator.
ACR Technology
This year, ASUS even added two layers of Ambient Contrast Ratio film to the display, which reduces reflections by 55% and provides up to 4.5x better contrast, ensuring the image stays punchy, vivid, and accurate. A second layer boosts viewing angle for a 180° ultra-clear view, providing an image that looks just as good off-center as it does straight on. This machine doesn't just perform at a high level – it draws you into the visuals, with colours so realistic it’s as if you were right in the middle of the action.
A Breath of Fresh Air
The cooling solution of the 2025 Strix G16 has also undergone a redseign, to ensure that you get the best gaming experience with your machine, every time. ASUS have relocated all of the exhaust vents to the rear of the hinge, keeping warm air away from your mousing hand. The sides and bottom of the machine act as an air intake, creating a natural, efficient path for airflow. Air also flows through the keyboard deck, keeping your hands cooler during intense gaming sessions. When pairing an end-to-end vapor chamber with a sandwiched heatsink, Tri-Fan Technology, and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal on both CPU & GPU, the 2025 Strix G16 achieves a lower noise level in Turbo Mode compared to the previous generation, while still offering the same calculated excellence you expect from a Strix machine.

Design and Build
The ASUS ROG Strix G16
G615LR is a performance-focused 16-inch gaming laptop with a distinctive
Eclipse Gray finish and a modern ROG design. Its larger chassis provides
space for a full-size keyboard, dedicated graphics hardware, cooling
components, and a spacious display. The overall structure is designed
around gaming and high-performance computing while retaining a practical
layout for everyday use. The keyboard includes RGB backlighting, while
the chassis provides a selection of connectivity options for peripherals
and external displays, making it suitable for both gaming setups and
general productivity environments.
Display and Viewing
Experience
The laptop features a
16-inch IPS-Level display with a 2560 × 1600 resolution and a 240Hz
refresh rate. The panel has a 16:10 aspect ratio, anti-glare treatment,
and a brightness rating of up to 500 nits. It also supports 100% DCI-P3
colour coverage, HDR, Dolby Vision, and NVIDIA G-SYNC technology. This
display configuration provides a combination of high resolution, wide
colour coverage, and a high refresh rate, making the screen suitable for
gaming, multimedia, creative applications, and everyday visual content.
Performance and Graphics
The ASUS ROG Strix G16
G615LR is configured with an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor and
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU with 12GB of GDDR7 graphics
memory. The processor features 24 cores and supports boost frequencies
of up to 5.4GHz, while Intel AI Boost provides an integrated NPU for
supported AI workloads. The dedicated NVIDIA graphics system is designed
for demanding graphical applications and gaming, with NVIDIA G-SYNC and
other display technologies integrated into the overall platform.
Memory and Storage
This configuration
includes 32GB of DDR5-5600 memory arranged across two SO-DIMM modules,
with support for up to 64GB depending on configuration. Storage is
provided through a 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe M.2 SSD, giving the system a
spacious internal storage arrangement for applications, games,
documents, and media. The combination of SO-DIMM memory and M.2 storage
also provides a structured internal layout for a performance-oriented
laptop, while the available memory slots allow flexibility for future
memory configurations.
Connectivity and Features
The ROG Strix G16 provides
a broad selection of modern connectivity options, including three USB
3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, two Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI 2.1, Gigabit
Ethernet, and a combined headphone and microphone jack. Wireless
connectivity includes Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4, while the network
connection supports up to 2.5Gbps Ethernet. It also features a Full HD
infrared camera, built-in microphone, stereo speakers, Dolby Atmos
audio, and a range of connectivity options for external displays and
accessories.
Gaming and Everyday Use
The ASUS ROG Strix G16
G615LR combines a large high-resolution display with dedicated graphics,
high-speed memory, fast NVMe storage, and extensive connectivity. Its
240Hz display, G-SYNC support, RGB keyboard, and performance-oriented
hardware give it a clear gaming-focused character, while the spacious
screen and full range of ports also make it suitable for productivity,
content creation, and other demanding computing tasks. The overall
design brings together the hardware and features expected from a modern
ROG Strix performance laptop in a single 16-inch platform.

With up to an Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 processor, a GeForce RTX™ 5070 Ti Laptop GPU and Mini LED display delivering unparalleled color accuracy and refresh rates, this powerhouse is ready for gamers and professionals alike. Advanced cooling ensures consistent performance, while Wi-Fi 6E and Thunderbolt™ 4 provide the high-speed connectivity you need.
DESKTOP-LEVEL PERFORMANCE, ANYWHERE.
Get legendary gaming performance with the Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 processor, delivering ultra-smooth gameplay and future-ready AI. Offload tasks like background removal and audio optimization to the NPU for seamless streaming, while Intel® Application Optimization™ enhances performance on classic titles.
SUPREME SPEED. SUPERIOR VISUALS. POWERED BY AI.
DLSS is a revolutionary suite of neural rendering technologies that uses AI to boost FPS, reduce latency, and improve image quality. The latest breakthrough, DLSS 4, brings new Multi Frame Generation and enhanced Ray Reconstruction and Super Resolution, powered by GeForce RTX™ 50 Series GPUs and fifth-generation Tensor Cores. DLSS on GeForce RTX is the best way to play, backed by an NVIDIA AI supercomputer in the cloud constantly improving your PC’s gaming capabilities.
GAME-CHANGING REALISM
The NVIDIA Blackwell architecture unlocks the game-changing realism of full ray tracing. Experience cinematic quality visuals at unprecedented speed powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series with fourth-gen RT Cores and breakthrough neural rendering technologies accelerated with fifth-gen Tensor Cores.
COMPETE AT WARP SPEED
Reflex technologies optimize the graphics pipeline for ultimate responsiveness, providing faster target acquisition, quicker reaction times, and improved aim precision in competitive games. Reflex 2 introduces Frame Warp, which further reduces latency based on the game’s latest mouse input.
NVIDIA POWERS THE WORLD’S AI. AND YOURS.
Upgrade to advanced AI with NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ GPUs and accelerate your gaming, creating, productivity, and development. Thanks to built-in AI processors, you get world-leading AI technology powering your Windows PC.
OPTIMIZED POWER AND PERFORMANCE
Max-Q is designed from the ground up for maximum efficiency, delivering a massive leap in performance and battery life.
VIBRANT MINI LED DISPLAY
Immerse yourself in stunning visuals with up to an 18” Mini LED WQXGA display. Featuring up to 250Hz refresh rate and DCI-P3 100% color accuracy, every scene comes to life.
ADVANCED COOLING SYSTEM
Stay ahead of the heat with 5th Gen AeroBlade™ 3D fans, liquid metal grease, and precision-engineered airflow. Designed to keep your system running smoothly, no matter the challenge.
CONTROL WITH PREDATORSENSE™ AND EXPERIENCE ZONE
PredatorSense™ gives you real-time control over system performance—adjust performance modes, manage fan speeds, and customize RGB lighting with precision. In the Experience Zone, tap into AI-powered features like PurifiedView for automatic framing and PurifiedVoice™ 2.0 for enhanced voice clarity.
ACER PROCAM™
Acer ProCam automatically recognizes gameplay highlights and records those moments.
ACER PURIFIEDVIEW™ 2.0
Step into a world of AI-enhanced clarity with advanced Portrait Refinement, Super Sharp visuals, and automatic framing. Enjoy natural background blur, gaze correction, and Acer TNR for vibrant, sharper images, even in low light. Perfect for seamless virtual meetings, live streaming, and video calls.
ACER PURIFIEDVOICE™ 2.0
Utilizing AI algorithms and a 3rd mic to identify and suppress unwanted background noise, Acer PurifiedVoice™ 2.0 delivers distraction-free audio for more engaging communication experiences.
DYNAMIC 4-ZONE RGB LIGHTING
Personalize your rig with 4-zone RGB keyboard lighting and customizable cover illumination. Designed for those who want to make their setup as unique as their gameplay.
OPTIMIZE WITH INTEL® APPLICATION OPTIMIZATION
Experience constant evolution with Intel® Application Optimization™. AI-driven updates fine-tune your system’s performance, giving you the upper hand in select titles. Intel® APO ensures smoother gameplay, less latency, and automatic enhancements for the games that matter most.
DISCOVER YOUR NEXT FAVORITE GAME

Victory Accelerated
Game with the greatest, backed up by the power of an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. With 8 Performance and 16 Efficient cores, this next-gen silicon can drive high framerates in esports and AAA games alike. The G16 also has access to AI acceleration in select content creation apps, giving you incredible flexibility on how you can utilise this machine. The 2025 Strix G16 offers the very best Windows 11 gaming experience, featuring an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU with 8GB of VRAM and Advanced Optimus functionality. This killer hardware is complemented by 32GB of 5600MHz DDR5 RAM and 1TB of PCIe 4.0 storage.
A Dominant Force
High-performance gaming machines need high-performance processors, and up to Intel Core Ultra 9 processor 275HX absolutely delivers. With 24 cores and 24 threads, this gaming and multi-tasking beast can draw up to 75W when needed, ensuring that your games always stay buttery smooth.
Game Changer
Powered by NVIDIA Blackwell, GeForce RTX 50 Series Laptop GPUs bring game-changing capabilities to gamers and creators. Equipped with a massive level of AI horsepower, the RTX 50 Series enables new experiences and next-level graphics fidelity. Multiply performance with NVIDIA DLSS 4, generate images at unprecedented speed, and unleash your creativity with NVIDIA Studio. All in the thinnest and longest lasting RTX laptops, optimised by Max-Q.
NVIDIA Advanced Optimus
With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can automatically route frames from the discrete GPU directly to the display using a MUX switch, bypassing the integrated graphics. This pathing improves performance by 5-10% compared to machines without a MUX Switch, making sure you get the absolute best gaming experience--all without needing touch a single button. This automatic switching also preserves your machine's battery life, as it can dynamically transition between the high-power discrete GPU and the lower power integrated GPU. No matter what you’re doing, your machine will switch to the most optimised mode without you having to lift a finger.
ROG Nebula Display You can’t beat the enemy if you don’t see them coming. The Strix G16 boasts an ultra-fast 2.5K 240Hz Nebula display with a 3ms response time, ensuring you’ll always get the jump on your opponent. A 16:10 panel with 500 nits of brightness and 100% DCI-P3 coverage, the Strix G16 has incredible colour accuracy with pixel-perfect precision even in the most frenetic firefights. ASUS have also added a brand new ACR (Ambient Contrast Ratio) film, with two layers that cut down on glare to increase contrast for more vibrant visuals, as well as improving off-angle viewing for when you might have a spectator.
ACR Technology
This year, ASUS even added two layers of Ambient Contrast Ratio film to the display, which reduces reflections by 55% and provides up to 4.5x better contrast, ensuring the image stays punchy, vivid, and accurate. A second layer boosts viewing angle for a 180° ultra-clear view, providing an image that looks just as good off-center as it does straight on. This machine doesn't just perform at a high level – it draws you into the visuals, with colours so realistic it’s as if you were right in the middle of the action.
A Breath of Fresh Air
The cooling solution of the 2025 Strix G16 has also undergone a redseign, to ensure that you get the best gaming experience with your machine, every time. ASUS have relocated all of the exhaust vents to the rear of the hinge, keeping warm air away from your mousing hand. The sides and bottom of the machine act as an air intake, creating a natural, efficient path for airflow. Air also flows through the keyboard deck, keeping your hands cooler during intense gaming sessions. When pairing an end-to-end vapor chamber with a sandwiched heatsink, Tri-Fan Technology, and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal on both CPU & GPU, the 2025 Strix G16 achieves a lower noise level in Turbo Mode compared to the previous generation, while still offering the same calculated excellence you expect from a Strix machine.

Lenovo Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 – i9-14900HX / RTX 4080 / 32GB / 2TB NVMeI'm selling my Lenovo Legion Pro 7i Gen 9 (2024) as I'm upgrading to a desktop PC.The laptop is in very good overall condition and has been well looked after. The chassis has been regularly cleaned using safe methods and has no significant cosmetic damage. It has approximately 11 months of Lenovo warranty remaining.The laptop performs exactly as expected and is currently running excellent FPS in games and benchmarks.Warranty & service historyFor full transparency, the laptop has been sent to Lenovo for warranty service twice.The first time, I sent it in specifically to have the thermal paste/service checked rather than doing anything myself that could potentially affect the warranty. During Lenovo's testing, they identified a performance issue and replaced the entire motherboard under warranty.After this, I noticed occasional low 1% FPS drops in some games. The laptop otherwise performed normally, including during intensive gaming and benchmarking. It was sent back to Lenovo and the motherboard was replaced again.The 1% low FPS issue ultimately turned out not to be a hardware fault. It was diagnosed as a software/configuration issue and resolved accordingly. Since then, the laptop has been performing as it should, with excellent gaming and benchmark performance.The current motherboard was therefore installed by Lenovo as part of the warranty repair process, rather than being replaced or modified by myself.BatteryThe battery currently has 104 charge cycles, as shown in Lenovo Vantage.Please note that while the laptop itself has approximately 11 months of remaining warranty, the battery is not covered by the remaining warranty, as shown in the accompanying photos.Storage upgradeThe laptop comes with its original:1TB Samsung NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSDand an additional upgraded:1TB Kingston KC3000 NVMe PCIe 4.0 SSDgiving 2TB total NVMe storage.The additional Kingston SSD is the drive shown in the photos as KINGSTON SKC3000S1024G.ChargersIncluded are:Official Lenovo 330W chargerOfficial Lenovo USB-C charger supplied with the laptopThe 330W charger has a small cosmetic nick/damage to the cable, which is visible in the photos. It has not affected the charger's performance.I have occasionally noticed a slight vibration/tingling sensation from the metal lid when using this charger, which appears to depend on the wall socket/cable positioning. Changing the socket or cable position resolves it. This is disclosed for full transparency and is reflected in the photos.IncludedLenovo Legion Pro 7i laptopOriginal 330W Lenovo chargerOriginal Lenovo USB-C chargerAdditional Kingston KC3000 1TB SSDSwappable ceramic keycapsKeycap removal toolDoes not include Original Box

If you are a VAT registered business, or another organisation that could normally claim back VAT on eligible purchases, you will not be able to claim back VAT on goods sold under the VAT margin scheme.

listings.title: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 16" Ultra 9 185H 32GB 1TB SSD RTX 4060 WQXGA W11 OLED
listings.description:
Power, precision, and elegance define the 2024 Zephyrus G16. The sleek chassis and matte finish of the Zephyrus G16 simply beg to be touched. The Zephyrus G16 has always been defined by its portability, and the 2024 model is no exception.
ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 Intel Core Ultra 9 185H 32GB RAM 1TB SSD NVIDIA RTX 4060 16 inch WQXGA OLED 240Hz Windows 11 Home Laptop
Performance Meets Precision
Power, precision, and elegance define the 2024 Zephyrus G16. Thinner and sleeker than ever before, the Zephyrus G16 still has the same sense of style and individuality that has always set it apart from the crowd.
AI-Powered performance And LifeLike Graphics*
Built with the ultra-efficient NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture, they bring a quantum leap in performance with AI-powered DLSS 3 and enable lifelike virtual worlds with full ray tracing. Plus, the Max-Q suite of technologies optimises system performance, power, battery life, and acoustics for peak efficiency.
*Cyberpunk 2077 image captured on a desktop with new Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode ON, shown for illustrative purposes only. Actual performance varies by system.
Accelerate Your Ideas
NVIDIA Studio takes your creative projects to the next level. Unlock RTX and AI acceleration in top creative apps, NVIDIA Studio drivers for max stability, and a suite of exclusive tools to fast-track your creativity.
Optimised Power And Performance
NVIDIA Max-Q is an advanced suite of AI-powered technologies that optimise your system for peak efficiency. This enables blazing-fast laptops that are thin, quiet, and have amazing battery life.
The Future is Here
Game and create with ease on this Windows 11 Home powered machine. Featuring an Intel Core Ultra 9 processor 185H with AI accelerators and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 Laptop GPU, this 16-inch machine can easily handle the latest games and cutting-edge creative software alike. Whether youre in a video call, editing a video, or in a next generation game, AI is working tirelessly behind the scenes to improve your experience.
OLED is Here
For the first time on an ROG laptop, enjoy the ultra-fast response times and incredible contrast ratios that are only possible with OLED technology. This panel also boasts a 2.5K resolution, giving it incredible pixel density on a 16-inch screen, with a 240Hz refresh rate that makes all of your games look silky smooth. With 100% coverage of the DCI-P3 colour space, a delta E colour accuracy of less than 1, and VESA HDR True black 500 certification, prepare to be immersed in HDR content so lifelike that the screen melts away.
*Average tested result in MyASUS/ Armoury Crate Splendid Display P3 and sRGB colour gamut: Delta E < 1, +/- 0.5, and may vary by specification. Please note that the actual performance also may vary under different test procedures, equipment and patterns.
Cool, Calm, Collected
ROG Intelligent Cooling is a suite of components that work together in harmony to keep our high-performance laptops cool and quiet. The Zephyrus G16 boasts some never-before-seen additions to ROGs list of cooling technologies, including 2nd Generation Arc Flow Fans and a redesigned high-efficiency air outlet, also features tri-fan design, with a third auxiliary fan that helps to move excess system heat to the heatsinks. All models also sport liquid metal, an ultra-high performance thermal interface material. Taken together, these systems keep the machine operating at its peak while staying quieter than ever.
Keys to Mastery
The trackpad and keyboard are critical for controlling your laptop, so we spared no expense with the design of the Zephyrus G16. Despite being just a 16-inch device, the G16 boasts a large 16:10 aspect ratio, matching the proportions of the screen itself effortless scrolling. Weve also increased the keycap size by 12% for smoother typing as well, thanks to extra rigidity from the CNC machining. An extra long 1.7mm travel distance gives the keyboard a premium typing feel, and with a lifetime of 20 million presses, its a perfect long-term partner.
Sleek Design
The new Zephyrus G16 catches your eye the moment you see it. Precision CNC-machined from aluminum alloy, this high strength material accepts complex shapes and also looks absolutely gorgeous after being anodized in either Eclipse Grey or the all-new breathtaking Platinum White colourway. The sleek chassis and matte finish of the Zephyrus G16 simply beg to be touched.
Ultra-Portable
The Zephyrus G16 has always been defined by its portability, and the 2024 model is no exception. This incredible gaming machine is a true thin-and-light, weighing in at just 1.95kg, with some models measuring as low as 1.74cm thick. Paired with a 90Wh battery that supports fast charging from 0-50% in just 30 minutes and support for Wi-Fi 6E wireless networking, the Zephyrus G16 is the ultimate gaming and productivity machine for those on the move.
Pump Up The Volume
Get lost in the music with the new and improved woofers on the Zephyrus G16. With a staggering 47% volume increase and an ultra-low bass frequency of 100Hz, the G16 produces clear and vibrant sound that you wouldnt expect from an ultra-slim 16-inch machine. Whether youre vibing to your favorite podcast

If you are a consumer buying for personal use, it does not affect you. The price you see is the price you pay. Security professionals can use Kali Linux to simulate real-world attacks on systems and networks to identify vulnerabilities before malicious actors can exploit them.

Kali Linux can be used by ethical hackers to test the security of systems and networks with the permission of the owner, helping to identify and fix vulnerabilities.
Vulnerability Research:
Security researchers can use Kali Linux to discover new vulnerabilities in software and hardware, which can then be reported to the vendors for patching.

Here at CPR, we don't believe in loading loads of software onto a new laptop (AKA Bloatware). Only the operating system and brand-related apps are downloaded. The Office 365 app can be installed directly from the Microsoft store or website.
Battery Condition
Battery life can vary significantly depending on usage. Laptops will always use more power when a DVD is playing or a game than just surfing the internet or answering emails. To this end, predicting an accurate life expectancy is difficult. However, to help, we test and grade batteries for laptops by real-life scenarios in that once fully refurbished, all laptops are specification checked (which involves running software on the machine for about 20 minutes). Browsing history and testing files removed using other software. At this point, the battery percentage is checked and noted above our opinion of the battery. On top of this, we use software (batteryinfoview) to verify this information and gain the percentage of health. Hopefully, this will give you a guide to the condition. Should you wish to purchase a new battery, these are very cheap and can extend your battery life (stock dependent).
Before we dispatch any Laptop:
Safety and security are important to us. Before any computer is shipped, we will have cleansed the hard drive, including previous boot sectors, thus eliminating any previously installed software. Then and only then will a PC be reinstalled with the appropriate operating system and refurbished for sale.

The everyday companion that does more
ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip is made for boosting productivity and having more fun — all day, every day. An innovative design, with a 360° hinge and garaged stylus, provides the flexibility to remote study or work the way you like best. An efficient MediaTek Kompanio 520 processor and up to 14-hour battery life gives you the freedom to stay productive throughout the day. The device also opens a gateway to the best of Google, including the rich library of apps for work and play, including the rich library of apps for work and play, found on Google Play. With speedy performance, robust security and convenient features, ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip is not only perfect for students and teachers — it’s ideal for anyone, anytime!
360° of style and elegance
ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip embodies pure style and a distinctively trendy look and feel in a new attractive colourway. Whether for study, work or relaxation, Gravity Grey creates a refined aesthetic and elegance that will fit any environment. The 360° hinge with touchscreen display allows it to be used in tablet, laptop, tent or stand mode — so it’s ideal for browsing websites, completing tasks and sharing content easily with friends and colleagues.
A stroke of genius
The garaged stylus features a new design that unleashes creativity and productivity with a simple push of the pen. You can take notes, sketch, or jot down those “Aha!” moments whenever innovative ideas strike. What’s more, it quickly and automatically charges when garaged either way — with a 15-second charge providing up to 45 minutes of use.
Tough enough to take anywhere
With structural reinforcements to boost chassis strength, ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip is solidly built and provides durability for all your travels. It also meets next-level and industry-leading MIL-STD 810H4 US military tests, which are more rigorous and demanding than ever before. Additionally, the device undergoes stringent in-house testing — including panel-pressure, shock and drop tests — for ensuring maximal toughness, so you don’t have to worry about everyday knocks and bumps. Sustainability is also embraced, with the inclusion of multiple recycled materials to create a product that is more environmentally friendly overall.
Level-up remote experiences
ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip ensures smooth and instant visuals. With a newly-integrated technology, it provides fresh, uplifting experiences when taking pictures or video conferencing.
Exceptional typing comfort
A full-size, ergonomic keyboard with 1.5 mm key travel ensures that typing is supremely comfortable. Typing on a compact device has never been this smooth and easy!
Faster, stable connections
ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip offers dual-band WiFi 6 for strong, stable signals and superfast speeds, allowing you to load online content in the blink of an eye. Its connectivity is made even better by exclusive ASUS technologies — such as ASUS WiFi Master for ChromeOS — that ensure greater speed, stability and range for your WiFi connections and help you stay connected anywhere.
Breeze through work
Powered by the latest MediaTek Kompanio 520 processor, ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip delivers excellent performance for responsive experiences with your favourite apps. Combined with the full capabilities of Google Workspace and other productivity apps found on Google Play, ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip has everything you need to get anything done, all in one place.
USB-C® for ultimate flexibility
Two full-function reversible USB-C® (USB Type-C®) ports make it easy to charge ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip or connect it to peripherals and external displays. USB-C provides superfast data-transfer speeds — making it possible to transfer a 2 GB video file to a USB drive in under 2 seconds! For maximum convenience and compatibility, ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip also features standard USB 3.2 ports, and there’s a microSD reader for adding more storage.
Enjoy the best of Google
It doesn’t get better than ChromeOS. For both work and relaxation, ASUS Chromebook CM14 Flip is your gateway to the very best of Google. You’ll enjoy full access to Google Play and find the apps you love to be productive, get entertained, play games or get creative.

High performance, guaranteed
As well as heaps of ultra-fast DDR5 memory and PCIe storage, the ThinkPad P16s Gen 2 (16″ Intel) has an Ultra Performance Mode to optimize power and maximize output. Secure & planet-minded

listings.description:
No matter where your work takes you, we’ve got a mode to accommodate your style. Dual fans double the cool factor - The underside of the keys on our legendary ThinkPad keyboard have been redesigned for air intake to create better airflow.
This listing is for a feature packed, ex-stock, updated and checked Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 14" OLED Touchscreen Intel Core i7-1260p 16GB RAM 512GB SSD 5G 2 in 1 Laptop in Storm Grey with Microsoft Windows 11 Pro Operating System.
A 14" 2-in-1 touchscreen laptop, the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 delivers features that matter. Enjoy the spectacular Communications Bar that raises the bar on collaboration. Robust security includes Tile® tracking technology—just in case. Plus, high-performance 12th Gen Intel Core vPro processing, on the Intel Evo platform provides super-responsive, on-the-go power.
Performance designed for you - Powered by 12th Gen Intel Core vPro processors—with up to 12 cores—the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 2-in-1 laptop takes multitasking to the next level. These CPUs have a revolutionary design that intelligently allocates workloads to the right thread, on the right core, at the right time—which allows for better video collaboration and productivity based on how you’re actually using your device.
More accommodating than a concierge - Thanks to its 360-degree hinge, the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 convertible laptop quickly switches between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes. No matter where your work takes you, we’ve got a mode to accommodate your style. Plus, go from keyboard to ThinkPad Pen Pro in seconds, when you want to sketch, sign documents, or take notes with the fully rechargeable, garaged pen.
Say hello to the Communications Bar - The ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 2-in-1 laptop boasts a premium experience with its new Communications Bar. The old webcam has been replaced with three FHD resolution options, including those with IR and Computer Vision technology. Four integrated AI-based noise-cancelling mics with Dolby Voice and four speakers with Dolby Atmos®up the ante on collaboration.
When every pixel matters - Whether vibrant colors are your jam or extra security to keep spying eyes away, the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 2-in-1 does not disappoint. The 4K WQUXGA OLED display, features a 16:10 aspect ratio, narrow bezels, multitouch, and low-power usage. Additionally, Eyesafe certified display options reduce blue-light emissions and eye fatigue.
Dual fans double the cool factor - The underside of the keys on our legendary ThinkPad keyboard have been redesigned for air intake to create better airflow. Combined with dual fans and rear venting, the thermal capabilities on the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 keep this convertible laptop cool even when it’s working overtime.
Security tailored to you - Biometrics provide extra security on the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 laptop—from the power button integrated with the fingerprint reader that lets you log in and boot up instantaneously, to the facial recognition software that works with the new IR camera. Plus, Computer Vision based presence detection automatically locks your device when you move away. And the optional PrivacyGuard keeps your screen your business.
Never lose track of your device - If you misplace your 2-in-1 laptop, or worse, if someone takes it, locating your PC has never been so easy. Now Tile ready, the ThinkPad X1 Yoga Gen 7 works with your smartphone to locate your device—even when your X1 is powered off. Simply subscribe to the Tile service, and then download, set up, and activate.
Tested to withstand the extremes - We use the US Department of Defense's MIL-STD 810H standards to create a balance of reliability and durability for our ThinkPad laptops. We test against 12 standards and more than 200 quality checks to ensure they run in extreme conditions. These tests cover harsh variables like Arctic wilderness and desert dust storms, including temperature, pressure, humidity, vibration, and more.

Cores and Threads Explained
Cores : These are the physical components within the CPU that perform actual processing tasks. Having more cores generally means better performance and the ability to handle more tasks simultaneously.
Threads : Threads are the smallest sequence of programmed instructions that can be managed independently by a scheduler. With technologies like Hyper-Threading (by Intel) or Simultaneous Multi-Threading each physical core can handle two threads, effectively doubling the number of tasks the CPU can manage at once.
Why It Matters
Performance : More cores and threads improve multitasking and performance, especially for tasks like video editing, gaming, or running multiple applications simultaneously.
Efficiency : It allows the CPU to distribute tasks more efficiently, reducing bottlenecks and improving overall system responsiveness.
Think of it like having 8 chefs (cores) in a kitchen, each capable of handling two dishes (threads) at the same time. So, your kitchen can work on 16 dishes simultaneously, improving the efficiency of your culinary operation!

• 12-Month Return-to-Base (RTB) Warranty: covers hardware faults and failures of software supplied by us – starting from the date of your sales invoice.

listings.description:

Lenovo Legion 5 Pro Laptop, Cable charger and box included. 256GB SSD with Windows 10, 32GB RAM, Ryzen 7 5800H CPU and NVIDIA RTX 3060 graphics card.
Issue with laptop:
- RTX 3060 dGPU does not work, when it is activated the laptop fans spin to max speed immediately and goes into black screen and shutdown. Suspected VRM/Mosfet/Power rail issue with the motherboard, however not 100% certain. The laptop works completely fine if the RTX 3060 gpu is disabled and using the AMD integrated gpu.
- Letter “D” on the keyboard does not work, the rest of the keyboard is completely fine
- Scuff on the bottom left of the chasis
- Scuff on the palm rest near touchpad from use
The rest of the laptop works completely fine, cpu, battery, ram and screen are in perfect condition.
RAM has been upgraded to ‘Crucial RAM 32GB kit (2x16GB) DDR4 3200Mhz CL22 CT2K16G4SFRA32A which is £250 by itself.
If you have any questions or need more information please feel free to ask.

listings.description:
Features 100% sRGB color gamut and a high refresh rate (165Hz or 240Hz). Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU. Raw power. Ready for restoration. An exceptional foundation of high-end silicon and premium display technology, waiting for the right technician to bring it back to full operational status.
Raw power. Ready for restoration.
An exceptional foundation of high-end silicon and premium display technology, waiting for the right technician to bring it back to full operational status. This is the 2022 Lenovo Legion 5i Pro Gen 7 (Model 16IAH7H) — sold strictly as an untouched project machine.
Technical Specifications
Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700H (2.3GHz Base Clock).
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU.
Display: 16-inch WQXGA (2560 x 1600) QHD+ 16:10 panel. Features 100% sRGB color gamut and a high refresh rate (165Hz or 240Hz).
Battery: Original Lenovo 80Wh / 5182mAh Li-ion (Model: L21D4PC1).
Keyboard: Full-size RGB backlit keyboard with numpad (UK Layout).
System BIOS: Version J2CN37WW.
Serial Number: PF3P5WQY.
Current Diagnostic State
This machine is being sold strictly for parts or repair with total transparency regarding its current operating condition:
BIOS Stability: The laptop powers on perfectly, successfully posts, and boots directly into the BIOS. It is completely stable in this state and will idle in the BIOS for hours without shutting down or experiencing thermal issues.
Operating System Power Loss: When attempting to boot an OS, the machine operates normally until it reaches the Windows login screen, at which point it instantly powers off.
Untouched Internals: This is a virgin board regarding repairs. The core issue is completely undiagnosed. No further testing has been performed, and absolutely no board-level repairs, micro-soldering, or component replacements have been attempted. The laptop has not been disassembled beyond the removal of the bottom chassis cover.
Cosmetics & Casing: The chassis shows standard signs of handling, including a cracked/broken section of plastic on the rear corner exhaust vent and cracks on chassis visible on pictures. Several bottom cover screws are missing.
What is NOT Included
To prepare this device for sale as a repair project, the following components have been removed and are not included in the auction:
Memory: No RAM included (Motherboard features standard DDR5 SODIMM slots).
Storage: No SSD included (M.2 NVMe slots are empty).
Power: No power supply or charger included.
A premium-tier gaming machine presenting a clean slate for a professional repair technician or a high-value donor board for existing projects. Sold entirely as-is.
